description: Golden set template for scripts/search_eval.py. Copy this file, replace the cases with real queries against your own banks, and add 30-50 cases for meaningful numbers. A case passes when a returned memory's id is in expected_ids OR its content contains any expected_substrings.

cases.query: uv sync が失敗する問題の対処
cases.note: Replace with a real query you actually ask, and a substring unique to the memory that should come back.
ID matching survives content edits; substring matching survives re-imports. Use whichever is stabler for the case.
